notes: MATNR is the join key across Material, Prices, and Stock; join on MATNR, never on row position.
Preserve MATNR and EAN11 as text so leading zeros and 13-digit barcode values are not lost.
The Legend explicitly states CTN = CARTON and that inventory quantities are individual pieces, so stock must not be multiplied by the 12-unit carton pack size.
Prices explicitly state currency THB, price list 'standard', VAT included = No, and tax rate 5%; these are source-backed values for this fixture, not inferred defaults.
The Legend sheet is reference metadata and should not create product records.

tables.reason: Material master listing one row per material with material number, Thai product name, EAN barcode, base unit, and carton pack size; MATNR is unique across all 12 rows.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: SAP material-number header MATNR, 12 distinct values for 12 rows; leading-zero pattern 00470001–00470012 indicates the customer SKU must remain text.

columns.name: MAKTX
columns.reason: SAP material-description field MAKTX containing Thai product names, one unique name per material.

columns.name: EAN11
columns.reason: EAN11 is the SAP EAN/barcode field; all values are 13-digit numeric strings starting 088500123....

columns.name: MEINS
columns.reason: MEINS is the SAP base unit of measure; constant CTN, and the Legend maps CTN to CARTON.

columns.name: Units per carton
columns.reason: Explicit carton-content column, constant 12 for every material; matches the required pack-size semantic without needing multiplication.

tables.reason: Two-row reference legend, not a product table: it defines CTN as CARTON and states that inventory quantities are individual pieces, not cartons.

columns.name: Code
columns.reason: Lookup key containing CTN and the special legend label Stock basis; not a row-level product field.

columns.name: Meaning
columns.reason: Definition text for each code: CARTON for CTN and an instruction that stock is counted in pieces rather than cartons.

tables.reason: One standard price row per material with currency, price-list label, net amount, VAT flag, and tax rate.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: Material-number join key with 12 distinct values, matching the Material master's MATNR set.

columns.name: WAERS
columns.reason: SAP currency field WAERS, constant THB across all price rows.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Constant value 'standard', explicitly naming the price list required by the contract's standard price-list field.

columns.name: Net amount
columns.reason: Price-valued column with one distinct amount per material and header indicating the net sales amount; values are not null.

columns.name: VAT included
columns.reason: Explicit yes/no VAT-inclusion flag; all rows say No, so the mapped boolean must be false rather than inferred from country conventions.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Explicit tax-rate column, constant 5% in this fixture; must be parsed as 0.05, not replaced by the schema's 7% default.

tables.reason: Stock table with two warehouse rows per material; MATNR plus Warehouse identifies each inventory record, and quantities are stated by the Legend to be individual pieces.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: Material-number join key; each MATNR appears twice, corresponding to two warehouses, so it links to the product master rather than uniquely identifying a stock row alone.

columns.name: Warehouse
columns.reason: Warehouse/location column with two distinct site codes, BKK and CNX, repeated across all materials.

columns.name: Available pieces
columns.reason: Available stock quantity explicitly measured in pieces according to the Legend, so it maps directly to inventory qty without multiplying by the 12-piece carton pack size.

changes_from_draft: SKU: replaced plain trim(MATNR) with a text-safe expression that keeps 8-character zero-padded text and restores leading zeros if the cell is read as a number (operator requirement 'preserve leading zeros').
Barcode: same protection for EAN11 so the leading 0 of the 13-digit EAN is not lost.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate mapped from the explicit 'Tax rate' column via parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction) → 0.05, instead of silently taking the schema default 0.07.
Price list: dropped the large fuzzy map_values dictionary (unnecessary and risky for a single constant 'standard'); now trim + lower, preserving the source value.

Currency: kept THB, now documented as source-backed (Prices.WAERS = THB on all 12 rows) rather than a bare default; no join was added to the pricing sheet so the collection link on MATNR stays unambiguous.
Warehouse code normalised with trim+upper; inventory qty used as individual pieces per the Legend, never multiplied by the 12-piece carton pack size.
Record dedupe set to /sku (identity key) instead of empty, keep first.
Legend source kept (id products_1) but its role changed to 'other' and it produces no records — it only evidences CTN = CARTON and the pieces stock basis.
Removed the draft's misleading question about the Legend 'Code' column being currency: that column holds unit codes/reference text, and currency is explicit in Prices.WAERS.

/status intentionally left unmapped: no source column carries status, and the contract default 'active' applies (no fabricated value). /category, /brand, /description, /prices/*/effective_from|effective_to and /inventory/*/reserved also have no source columns and are omitted rather than invented.
Unit sell unit normalised via unit_normalize with CTN → CARTON backed by the Legend; pack size taken from the explicit 'Units per carton' column.
